20427-custer-and-other-poems.title: Other Poems
20427-custer-and-other-poems.creator: Unknown
20427-custer-and-other-poems.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. To those who burn the candle to the stick, The sputtering socket yields but little light. Long life is sadder than an early death. We cannot count on raveled threads of age Whereof to weave a fabric. We must use The warp and woof the ready present yields And toil while daylight lasts. When I bethink How brief the past, the future still more brief, Calls on to action, action!

arxiv-2106-02768.title: Dual Attentive Sequential Learning for Cross-Domain Click-Through Rate Prediction Conference: Proceedings of the 27th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining; August 14–18, 2021; Virtual Event, Singapore Proceedings of the 27th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Da

arxiv-2106-02768.description: Abstract . Cross domain recommender system constitutes a powerful method to tackle the cold-start and sparsity problem by aggregating and transferring user preferences across multiple category domains. Therefore, it has great potential to improve click-through-rate prediction performance in online commerce platforms having many domains of products.

arxiv-2110-00204.title: Effects of Many-body Interactions in Hypernuclei with Korea-IBS-Daegu-SKKU Functionals
arxiv-2110-00204.creator: Soonchul Choi, Emiko Hiyama, Chang Ho Hyun, Myung-Ki Cheoun
arxiv-2110-00204.description: Abstract We investigate the properties of Λ \Lambda hyperon in Λ \Lambda -hypernuclei using an effective nuclear density functional theory which is based on the low-energy effective field theory. It expands the energy density in the power of Fermi momentum, and consequently has multiple density dependence for the effective many-body interactions.

arxiv-2201-03833.description: Abstract We interprete results of Markman on monodromy operators as a universality statement for descendent integrals over moduli spaces of stable sheaves on K ​ 3 K3 surfaces. This yields effective methods to reduce these descendent integrals to integrals over the punctual Hilbert scheme of the K ​ 3 K3 surface.

arxiv-2406-00042.title: Rise and Fall of Anderson Localization by Lattice Vibrations: A Time-Dependent Machine Learning Approach
arxiv-2406-00042.creator: Yoel Zimmermann, Joonas Keski-Rahkonen, Anton M. Graf, Eric J. Heller
arxiv-2406-00042.description: Abstract The intricate relationship between electrons and the crystal lattice is a linchpin in condensed matter, traditionally described by the Fröhlich model encompassing the lowest-order lattice-electron coupling. Recently developed quantum acoustics, emphasizing the wave nature of lattice vibrations, has enabled the exploration of previously uncharted territories of electron–lattice interaction not accessible with conventional tools such as perturbation theory.

arxiv-2410-17120.title: On Lyapunov Conditions for the Well-Posedness of McKean-Vlasov Stochastic Differential Delay Equations
arxiv-2410-17120.creator: Dan Noelck
arxiv-2410-17120.description: Abstract This work focuses on the well-posedness of McKean-Vlasov stochastic differential delay equations. Under suitable Lipschitz conditions on the drift and diffusion terms, along with a distribution dependent Lyapunov condition, this paper shows the existence of a unique solution to the distribution dependent stochastic differential delay equation. Keywords. McKean-Vlasov stochastic differential equation, Stochastic delay equation, Well-Posedness, Lyapunov Condition.

arxiv-2504-18206.title: A Machine Learning Approach For Bitcoin Forecasting
arxiv-2504-18206.creator: Stefano Sossi-Rojas 1, Gissel Velarde 1, Damian Zieba 2
arxiv-2504-18206.description: Abstract Bitcoin is one of the cryptocurrencies that is gaining more popularity in recent years. Previous studies have shown that closing price alone is not enough to forecast stock market series. We introduce a new set of time series and demonstrate that a subset is necessary to improve directional accuracy based on a machine learning ensemble.

openalex-w7205011561.title: CONTAMINAÇÃO ALIMENTAR POR LISTERIA MONOCYTOGENES: PATOGÊNESE, FORMAÇÃO DE BIOFILMES E IMPACTOS NA SAÚDE PÚBLICA
openalex-w7205011561.creator: Jaqueline Santos Teles Bahia, Felipe Teles Bahia
openalex-w7205011561.source: OpenAlex / Revista Ibero-Americana de Humanidades, Ciências e Educação
openalex-w7205011561.description: A listeriose é uma grave infecção de origem alimentar ocasionada pela bactéria Listeria monocytogenes, um patógeno intracelular facultativo de distribuição ubiquitária. O presente estudo objetiva analisar o processo patogênico da bactéria, suas manifestações clínicas em grupos...

pmc-10532132.title: Etiology of Bronchiectasis in the World: Data from the Published National and International Registries
pmc-10532132.creator: Jose Daniel Gómez-Olivas, Grace Oscullo, Miguel Ángel Martínez-García
pmc-10532132.description: Bronchiectasis is the third leading chronic inflammatory disease of the airway caused by dozens of pulmonary and extra-pulmonary diseases. Infection by pathogenic microorganisms is very common. We aimed to analyze, for the first time in the literature, the etiology of bronchiectasis throughout the world via data published in national and international registries.

pmc-10563264.title: Large mesenchymal cystic and chondroid pulmonary hamartoma mimicking lung cancer: Case report
pmc-10563264.creator: Seha Ahn, Heejin Lee, Joon Kyu Kang, In Sub Kim, Youngkyu Moon, Jung Suk Choi, Si Young Choi
pmc-10563264.description: Pulmonary hamartoma is the most commonly resected benign neoplasm of lung. The mesenchymal cystic subtype is a rare and often bilaterally occurring variant composed of multiple cysts and nodules. Herein, we present an asymptomatic 70-year-old woman with a large and mostly cystic growth of right hilar region.

pmc-11402519.title: Effective number of different populations: A new concept and how to use it
pmc-11402519.creator: Evsey Kosman, Frida Feijen, Jukka Jokela
pmc-11402519.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Widely used methods to assess population genetic structure and differentiation rely on independence of marker loci. Following the assumption, the common metrics, for example F ST, evaluate genetic structure by averaging across loci. Common metrics do not use information in the associations among loci at the individual level and are often criticized for failing to measure true differentiation even when loci segregate independently. We introduce a new concept to measure β‐variation (Effective Number of Different Populations, ENDP).

pmc-11434482.title: Driving Forces in the Formation of Paracetamol Cocrystals and Solvate with Naphthalene, Quinoline and Acridine
pmc-11434482.creator: Tadeusz M. Muzioł, Emilia Bronikowska
pmc-11434482.description: Paracetamol is an important analgesic and antipyretic drug showing poor tabletability. Among the various approaches used to improve this property, understanding the forces that govern the crystal packing is revealed to be crucial. We prepared three stable compounds: (par)2∙(nap) (1), (par)∙(quin) (2), and (par)∙(acr) (3) (nap—naphthalene, quin—quinoline, acr—acridine) being cocrystals or solvate.

pmc-11504051.title: Associations between Disc Hemorrhage and Primary Open-Angle Glaucoma Based on Genome-Wide Association and Mendelian Randomization Analyses
pmc-11504051.creator: Je Hyun Seo, Young Lee, Hyuk Jin Choi
pmc-11504051.description: Background/Objectives: We aimed to investigate the genetic loci related to disc hemorrhage (DH) and the relationship of causation between DH and primary open-angle glaucoma (POAG) using a genome-wide association study (GWAS) in East Asian individuals. Methods: The GWAS included 8488 Koreans who underwent ocular examination including fundus photography to determine the presence of DH and POAG.

pmc-11805099.title: Efficacy of Endodontic Cryotherapy in Alleviating Post-Treatment Pain after Single-Visit RCT: A Randomized Study
pmc-11805099.creator: Prasad Chandrakant Ingale, Simran Sethi, Sukruti Suresh Babu, Khushi Rathod, Rahul Sharma, Shanu Khan
pmc-11805099.description: Aim:This study aims to assess whether endodontic cryotherapy can effectively lower discomfort after a single root canal visit.Material and Method:Thirty-six patients aged 18–32 years requiring single-visit root canal treatment (RCT) were divided into three groups at random, with twelve people in each: group 1 (control group), group 2 (normal saline), and group 3 (cold saline).

pmc-11816183.title: Effectiveness of a video-based intervention to improve the interpersonal communication skills of public health midwives in a district of Sri Lanka: a cluster randomised trial
pmc-11816183.creator: S A S Prasanna, H T C S Abeysena, M A A P Alagiyawanna
pmc-11816183.description: ObjectiveTo determine the effectiveness of a video-based intervention, the V-BIS, in improving the interpersonal communication skills (IPCS) of public health midwives (PHMs).DesignA cluster randomised trial.SettingThe setting is a Medical Officer of Health (MOH) area, the district’s basic administrative unit in public health.

pmc-12654706.title: Comparison of Cryoballoon Ablation Methods in Pulmonary Vein Isolation
pmc-12654706.creator: Kaspars Kupics, Raivis Bricis, Kristine Jubele, Ieva Ansaberga, Oskars Kalējs, Andrejs Erglis
pmc-12654706.description: Background and Objectives: Cryoballoon ablation is a well-established therapy for atrial fibrillation (AF), enabling pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) using a single-shot technique. The two primary systems—Medtronic Arctic Front and the newer Boston Scientific POLARx—differ in design and performance characteristics, but few direct comparisons exist.

pmc-13559495.title: Bidirectional EEG Neurofeedback of Sensorimotor Beta Oscillations Reveals Asymmetric Modulation and Strategy‐Dependent Learning
pmc-13559495.creator: Krithika Anil, Stephen Hall, Jennifer A. Freeman, Jonathan Marsden, Giorgio Ganis
pmc-13559495.description: EEG‐based neurofeedback (ENF) may be utilised as an intervention for improvement of motor performance in Parkinson's movement impairment. This exploratory study aimed to determine the ability of healthy participants to bidirectionally modulate sensorimotor beta power using ENF in real time and examine learning trends.

pmc-13673797.title: Personal Innovativeness and Digital Entrepreneurial Intention: A Social Cognitive Perspective and the Moderating Role of AI Adoption
pmc-13673797.creator: Bao Quoc Lam, Hao Yen Tran, Nguyen Thi Hoa Hong
pmc-13673797.description: BackgroundDespite the rapid growth of digital entrepreneurship and increasing adoption of artificial intelligence (AI), existing explanations of digital entrepreneurial intention (DEI) remain fragmented and inconsistent. Prior studies have primarily focused on either individual cognitive factors or technology adoption, while limited attention has been given to how AI-supported environments interact with psychological mechanisms underlying entrepreneurial intention formation.

uslaw-usc-t16-s354.title: 16 U.S.C. § 354 — Offenses; punishment
uslaw-usc-t16-s354.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s354.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 1 (National Parks, Military Parks, Monuments, And Seashores); Subchapter XXXIX (Denali National Park). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Any person found guilty of violating any of the provisions of this subchapter shall be deemed guilty of a misdemeanor, and shall be subjected to a fine of not more than $500 or imprisonment not exceeding six.
